newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles firms on more press comment.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles firms on more press comment.

text.p: Biocompatibles International Plc shares rose sharply for a second day on Friday as a report in the Financial Times highlighted the potential of its cardiovascular treatment and hinted at chances for a takeover bid.
The stock was up 32-1/2p at 897-1/2 by 0806 GMT in thin volume of 2,000 shares, after yesterday rising 45p on the back of a New Year stock tip in the Daily Mail newspaper.
